_comment: ONE flag per game: games[].live. Everything else (Play button, QR, JSON-LD install URL, badges, hub copy, from-app redirect, offers.json, Wall of Honor links, sitemap) is generated from it by scripts/apply_state.py. Flip with scripts/go_live.py <slug>.

games.name: Word Lodge
games.tagline: A cozy offline word-connect crossword puzzle: 1,720 levels, 35 worlds, no time limits.

whatsNew.title: What's new
items: Levels 1001 to 1720 rebuilt with fuller word plateaus and a rising finale.
Finishing level 1720 no longer loops back to level 1: replay any of the last 100 levels.
A single tap on a tile no longer counts as a wrong word.
Delete My Data now clears more local data.
Polish and fixes on Home, Shop, Settings and companion cards.

games.name: Arrow Away
games.tagline: A calm arrow puzzle: 4,000 levels, 100 worlds and ten elemental arrows to clear.

whatsNew.title: What's new
items: 4,000 levels in 100 worlds, with fresh boards from level 1.
Ten elemental arrows: Ember, Tide, Frost, Terra, Gale, Volt, Bloom, Forge, Dusk and Dawn.
Boss boards with several waves.
More arrow skins, trails and board themes.
An Awards screen, left-handed mode and colour-blind cues.
Bigger text and many fixes.

games.name: Snug Cats
games.tagline: A calm cat logic puzzle: one cat per row, column and blanket.

whatsNew.title: What's new
items: 400 cat logic puzzles, from 4x4 to 11x11.
A smoother difficulty curve across the whole climb.
Clearer text, tidier layouts and many small fixes.
Delete My Data keeps what you bought.

games.name: Pixel Picnic
games.tagline: A cozy pixel puzzle: send hungry ants to eat colorful pixel art, one layer at a time.

whatsNew.title: What's new
items: Little creatures on the move: ants crawl at a calm pace, bees buzz, butterflies flutter, and every critter carries its bite home to its nest.
Pictures reveal bite by bite: cells no longer vanish before a critter reaches them.
Delete My Data also removes your Photo Mode puzzles.
Layout and polish fixes across Home, Shop and Settings.

games.name: Style Drop
games.tagline: Watch the runway look, rebuild the outfit, earn five stars: a dress up memory game.

whatsNew.title: What's new
items: 12 runway levels plus a new Daily Look, 12 themed style briefs and 41 wardrobe pieces.
Three models to style: Romy, Wren and Zee.
Delete My Data keeps your Style Pass.
The Red Carpet set now includes all five Glam pieces.
Easier coin pacing on the last three challenges.
Text and layout fixes.

games.name: Glimmer Grove
games.tagline: A cozy idle garden game of glowing plants, garden spirits and 48 moonlit Nights.

whatsNew.title: What's new
items: Nights 9 to 48 each play differently: new wave shapes, storms and Great Gloom nights.
Fairer rewards: bonus videos pay out only after a real ad, plus Dew balance fixes.
A clearer shop, quest cards and Item Guide, with many text-fit fixes.
Delete My Data now also clears Night progress.
Plays fully offline.

games.name: Burrow Buddy
games.tagline: Adopt a woodland buddy, cook, decorate and dig deep in a cozy burrow. Plays offline.

whatsNew.title: What's new
items: Quick Mix: cook a dish from your pantry in one tap.
20 recipes to discover, Chef Combos included.
Dig Deep: four layers down to 200 m.
Harvest Moon event with a collectible decor set.
Soft Mode: a calmer, quieter sound option.
Clearer text and tidier menus.
Delete My Data now clears dig progress too.
